documents.title: Annual Leave and Vacation Policy
documents.content: All full-time employees are entitled to 20 business days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance via the HR portal. Unused leave up to 5 days may be carried over to the subsequent calendar year.

documents.title: Incident Response Escalation Matrix
documents.content: Severity 1 (P0) security incidents require immediate escalation to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and the Incident Commander within 15 minutes of detection. All incident containment actions must be logged in the forensic ticketing system.

documents.title: Production Deployment Safety Gates
documents.content: Deployments to production require a passing automated test suite with at least 80% code coverage and peer review approvals from at least two senior engineers. Production deployments are frozen between 18:00 UTC Friday and 06:00 UTC Monday.
